remarks: BEST AND FINAL BY MONDAY, 4/27 AT NOON. Welcome to this beautifully maintained 5-bedroom Cape Cod Colonial, perfectly situated on over an acre of flat, usable property in desirable South Wilton. This turnkey home is in mint condition and offers the ideal blend of classic charm and modern updates. Inside, you'll find gleaming hardwood floors throughout and a thoughtfully designed layout featuring three fully updated bathrooms. The spacious kitchen is a true highlight, appointed with quartz countertops, a premium Viking gas stove, wall oven, microwave, dishwasher, and refrigerator. An inviting dining area with sliders opens seamlessly to the deck, creating the perfect setting for indoor-outdoor living and entertaining.A standout feature of this home is the legal one-bedroom apartment with its own private entrance-ideal for extended family, guests, or rental income. This space can easily be incorporated back into the main home if desired, offering flexibility to suit your needs.Additional features include a lower level with a two-car tandem garage, central air conditioning, and ample storage. The expansive property provides endless possibilities for recreation, gardening, or future enhancements. Conveniently located with easy access to the train, major highways, town center, and top-rated schools, this home offers both tranquility and accessibility. A rare opportunity to own a move-in ready home in one of Wilton's most sought-after locations. Shed sold "as is"
